## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes: lint, format, types, the tests with the coverage floor, the docs check
- [ ] New behaviour has tests, including failure paths; a bug fix starts with a test that failed
- [ ] The docs describe the change, and `make site` builds
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under *Unreleased*
- [ ] Significant decisions are recorded in `docs/DECISIONS.md`
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or real customer data in code, tests, fixtures or logs
